metadata.name: WhatsApp Windows Automation
metadata.description: Controls the WhatsApp Windows desktop app to send messages, make voice calls and video calls, triggered by schedule or voice command.
metadata.author: Hybrid Local AI Hub

data.label: Voice / Text Command Input
data.text: send whatsapp message to +919876543210: Hey! Meeting at 5pm today.
data.description: Type or paste a command here. Supports: 'send message to <phone>: <text>', 'call <phone>', 'video call <phone>'. For voice: pipe your microphone transcript here.

data.label: Scheduled Message Trigger
data.description: Fires every day at 9:00 AM. Customize the cron expression. When fired, passes the TextInputNode value as the scheduled message.

data.label: Merge Triggers
data.description: Whichever trigger fires first (voice command or schedule) passes through to the AI parser.

data.label: AI: Parse User Command
data.promptTemplate:
You are a WhatsApp automation assistant running on Windows. Parse the user command and extract intent.

User Command: {{input}}

Return ONLY a valid JSON object with these exact fields:
{
  "action": "send_message" OR "voice_call" OR "video_call",
  "phone": "<international format phone number, e.g. +919876543210>",
  "message": "<message text, empty string if action is a call>"
}

If the command says 'call' without specifying video, use voice_call.
If it says 'video call', use video_call.
If it says 'send', 'text', 'message', use send_message.
Only return the JSON.

data.label: Route: Message or Call?
data.description: If action is send_message, routes to message branch (true). Otherwise routes to call branch (false).

data.label: Send WhatsApp Message (Windows)
args: $raw = '{{input}}'; $data = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $phone = $data.phone -replace '\+',''; $msg = [System.Uri]::EscapeDataString($data.message); Start-Process "whatsapp://send?phone=$phone&text=$msg"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait('%{ENTER}'); Write-Host "Message sent to $($data.phone): $($data.message)"
data.description: Opens WhatsApp Windows app via its whatsapp:// URI scheme to the chat with the contact and pre-fills the message. Then presses Alt+Enter to send. Requires WhatsApp for Windows to be installed.

data.label: WhatsApp Voice / Video Call (Windows)
args: $raw = '{{input}}'; $data = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $phone = $data.phone -replace '\+',''; $action = $data.action; if ($action -eq 'video_call') { Start-Process "whatsapp://videocall?phone=$phone"; Write-Host "Video call initiated to $($data.phone)" } else { Start-Process "whatsapp://call?phone=$phone"; Write-Host "Voice call initiated to $($data.phone)" }
data.description: Uses WhatsApp Windows deep links to start a voice or video call. whatsapp://call?phone=NUMBER for voice. whatsapp://videocall?phone=NUMBER for video.
